title: Create: Beyond the Horizon
description: Create: Beyond the Horizon is an exploration-focused modpack built around Create Aeronautics, encouraging players to construct airships and explore!
body:
Take to the skies and forge your own path across a world filled with opportunity, adventure, and discovery.**

Create: Beyond the Horizon is an exploration-focused modpack built around Create Aeronautics, encouraging players to construct airships, establish trade routes, and venture far beyond their starting point. Progression rewards curiosity and exploration, with new structures, landscapes, and hidden points of interest waiting to be discovered across the world.

**Features:**
- Create and Create Aeronautics progression
- Design and pilot your own airships
- Enhanced world generation and exploration
- New structures and landmarks to discover
- Expanded cave and underground adventures
- Carefully balanced progression and survival
- Multiplayer-friendly gameplay
- Secrets and mysteries hidden throughout the world

Whether you're charting unknown territory from the deck of an airship, building a network of automated industries, or setting out in search of forgotten ruins, the next great discovery is always waiting just beyond the horizon.

**Build. Fly. Explore. Discover.**
